record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare MAGIC_BOUNCE: Natu (1 star) and Xatu (2 stars); both maxPP 70, range 2, no passive. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count, which sets the bounce factor when the status later bounces damage.
record.summary: Needs no target. The cast itself only spends PP and gives the caster the magicBounce status for 5000 ms (the cooldown is only ever raised, never shortened). While the status is set, any handleSpecialDamage call against the holder is blocked completely: no damage, takenDamage 0, no death, spellBlockedCount incremented. If the blocked hit was of attack type SPECIAL with damage > 0 and the attacker does not hold Protective Pads, a bounce is queued 500 ms later: the attacker takes round(factor x incoming damage x (1 + holder AP/100) x holder critPower if the bounce crits) as SPECIAL damage, factor 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 4 by the holder's stars (Natu 1 star: 0.5, Xatu 2 stars: 1). The bounce is flagged isRetaliation so two bouncing units cannot loop. The cast deals no damage by itself.

targeting.who: the caster only (self status); the bounce later targets the attacker whose special damage was blocked
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so process runs with target null and the strategy never reads a target.

geometry.shape: none (self status; the bounce is single-target against the original attacker, at any distance)

effects.scaling: none; duration is a fixed 5000 ms, not scaled by AP or stars
effects.resolution: triggerMagicBounce(5000): sets magicBounce = true and raises magicBounceCooldown to 5000 only if 5000 is larger than the current cooldown (a longer existing cooldown, e.g. 10000 from a Rowap Berry, is kept). Status.update ticks the cooldown while the flag is set; the flag clears when cooldown - dt <= 0.

declaredRaw.blocks: every handleSpecialDamage call while magicBounce is set (as with protect and skydiving)

effects.resolution: the call returns { death: false, takenDamage: 0 } and increments spellBlockedCount. Applied change to HP: none. Requested incoming damage is discarded before any defense, shield or minimum-of-1 step (handleDamage is not reached for the blocked hit).

effects.target: the attacker of a blocked SPECIAL hit
effects.scaling: requested = round(factor[holder stars] x blocked damage x (1 + holder AP/100) x (bounce crit ? holder critPower : 1)). The blocked damage is the damage argument of handleSpecialDamage as passed in (it may itself already be scaled by the original attacker or ability). Bounce crit = the incoming crit flag, or the holder has ABILITY_CRIT and wins a critChance roll. Applied: the attacker's handleDamage resolves it as SPECIAL damage (special defense, shields, minimum 1, takenDamage including shield damage) per core-mechanics section A; this record did not re-trace those steps.
effects.resolution: requires attackType SPECIAL, damage > 0, a non-null attacker and no PROTECTIVE_PADS on the attacker; otherwise the hit is blocked with no bounce. Executed by a DelayedCommand after 500 ms with isRetaliation true, so the attacker's own reflect/bounce does not answer it. The holder is the attacker of record.

statusEffects.effect: magicBounce on the caster for 5000 ms (extended only, never shortened)
magicBounce is removed early when the holder is hit by BRICK_BREAK, RAGING_BULL or SHADOW_FORCE (they clear flag and cooldown); FOCUS_PUNCH does not eject a holder

starBehavior.note: the cast and its 5000 ms duration are identical at every star count; only the bounce factor depends on the holder's stars (0.5 / 1 / 2 / 4, fallback 4). 3 and 4 stars are not reached at these units' factory star counts; whether other mechanics change a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None for the cast. The bounce reaches the original attacker wherever it stands.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored mode. Recasting while the status is active keeps the larger of the current cooldown and 5000 (so it effectively refreshes to 5000 if less remained). The same status can also come from the Rowap Berry (10000 ms) and is removed by the three abilities listed.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: status duration 5000 ms; bounce factor 0.5 (Natu) / 1 (Xatu) of the blocked damage. Requested bounce = round(factor x blocked damage x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor). Applied to the attacker only after its handleDamage steps (special defense, shields, minimum 1); the holder takes 0 from the blocked hit. The blocked damage is the value at the handleSpecialDamage call, i.e. before the holder's defenses, since the block happens first.

Crit resolution of the cast - the strategy cannot crit by default and does not use the crit flag; only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
